run_cache_labels: run the cache_labels function to cache annotation or prediction labels into a task data column
run_cache_labels_job: run the cache_labels_job to extract and persist labels from annotations or predictions for a task queryset
extract_labels_from_annotation: extract labeled values from an annotation result using control tag filtering and taxonomy path formatting
generate_cache_labels_form: generate the cache_labels_form UI definition with control tag, counters, and source selector fields
register_cache_labels_action: register the cache_labels action entry point with permissions and confirmation dialog in the data manager
